about.title: How SKLAD works
about.text: We are a collective and a studio for digital creators – from 3D and motion to developers of interactive tools. Every member has their own desk, a place to work and a community to share know-how with.

highlights.title: Your own spot
highlights.text: A desk, a chair and a shelf are ready – just bring your own setup, or arrange the place the way you like.

highlights.title: Open admissions
highlights.text: Fill in the application, write to us, drop by for a tour and see whether SKLAD suits you. Start with a free 3-day trial and continue with a no-commitment trial month.

members.title: SKLAD members
members.text: Meet the people who make the space – and make things in it.

bio: Lukáš Dřevjaný, aka “oxoo”, is an audiovisual artist whose work is rooted in the rave underground and sits on the edge of contemporary digital art. Combining elements of abstract expressionism with a futuristic sensibility, he creates immersive visual experiences that challenge the viewer’s perception of reality. Through resonant colour and contrast he explores the tension between chaos and order, technology and humanity, and pushes the boundaries of traditional visual storytelling.

done.role: Coder and game developer, motion & sound designer
bio: He presents **Plantáž** – an interactive game about plants in a hostile environment. A fusion of Tamagotchi and Pokémon in an MMORPG world (GTA, WoW). With the project he points to the exponential growth of technology, the changing climate, and the absence of socialising and caring for others.

His work grows out of applying new technologies through which the digital world grows into the real one. He uses the rise of virtual reality (**VR**), which fully immerses you in a virtual environment through Meta Quest headsets, and augmented reality (**AR**), which adds digital elements to the camera image of your surroundings.
**Motion design** – animation is his main means of visual communication for catching attention. With **sound** he creates an emotional identification with the image.

bio: Jakub is a mobile app developer who has built two apps for controlling the physical world – one for smart homes and one for smart stables. He is now developing a community platform for collecting data about natural springs. In his free time he focuses on building workflows with AI agents and runs the online shop [notysky.cz](https://notysky.cz/).

items.question: How does applying work?
items.answer: Fill in the form, we will get back to you and arrange a tour. On site you will find out whether the space suits you.

items.question: What does membership include?
items.answer: A dedicated desk, a chair, a shelf, keys for 24/7 access, a kitchenette and toilets.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Membership costs CZK 5,000 per month. Payment is always due at the start of the period.

items.question: Is there a trial period?
items.answer: Yes. Come for three days for free, see how the space and the community suit you, and if you want to stay, we will offer you a no-commitment trial month.

items.question: Do I need my own desk?
items.answer: If you do not have a desk, we have desks ready to lend. Bring your own equipment.

items.question: Can I share my portfolio?
items.answer: Of course. Send us the videos and visuals you want to have on the website.

items.question: I am a software developer – do I belong in SKLAD?
items.answer: Absolutely. The community includes app developers and people who build interactive installations and their own tools. Collaboration across disciplines is what we enjoy.
